profiles.datasource: FUJIFILM data sheet AF3-0258E (NEOPAN 100 ACROS II, 135), p3: charts are 300 dpi raster images, traced at 600 dpi (spectrogram to 5400 K daylight; D-76 characteristic curves).
profiles.license: Built from FUJIFILM data sheet AF3-0258E. See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.

assumptions.log_sensitivity: SHEET (raster) 401-662 nm: the spectrogram to 5400 K daylight with a 5400 K black body divided out (ASSUMED source spectrum); ASSUMED held below 401 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0680 dex/nm above 662 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
assumptions.density_curves: SHEET (raster) for log_exposure -2.10..1.56 (D-76 small tank, 20 C, 7.25 min: the sheet's own time, interpolated between the 7 and 10 min curves; contrast index 0.572); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.802 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
assumptions.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 100 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/100)+1.0 = -1.097 log lux-s
assumptions.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
assumptions.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0139 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers

profiles.datasource: HARMAN technology Ltd, 'HP5 PLUS Technical Information' (Nov 2018), p1 (wedge spectrogram to 2850 K tungsten) and p5 (characteristic curve, ILFOTEC HC 1+31, 6.5 min): raster charts, traced at 600 dpi.
profiles.license: Built from HARMAN technology Ltd's HP5 PLUS technical information (Nov 2018). See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.

assumptions.log_sensitivity: SHEET (raster) 380-654 nm: the 'wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)' taken as drawn; ASSUMED its 0-1 'Sensitivity' axis is log units and ASSUMED the source is not to be divided out -- the reading that reproduces Ilford's own daylight filter factors for HP5 Plus (W8 1.7, W15 2.0; W25 comes out 6.2 against 4.0), where dividing a 2850 K black body out gives 2.9 / 4.2 / 16; ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0365 dex/nm above 654 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
assumptions.density_curves: SHEET (raster) for log_exposure -2.03..2.03 (ILFOTEC HC 1+31, 6.5 min, 20 C: the one curve the sheet plots; contrast index 0.599); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.634 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
assumptions.log_exposure_anchor: ASSUMED: the sheet's exposure axis is relative. 0 = one log unit above the curve's own D = base+fog + 0.1 point, i.e. the film is taken to have exactly its rated speed (ISO 400: log10(0.8/400)+1.0 = -1.699 log lux-s)
assumptions.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
assumptions.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0087 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers

profiles.datasource: HARMAN technology Ltd, "MULTIGRADE RC PAPERS Technical Information", June 2019 (MULTIGRADE-IV-RC-Papers-060619.pdf): characteristic curves for filters 00-5 (raster charts, p3), ISO R / ISO P tables (p2), spectral sensitivity chart (p1, no ordinate scale).
profiles.license: Fitted to HARMAN technology Ltd, MULTIGRADE RC PAPERS Technical Information (June 2019). See engine/resources_product/NOTICE.md.
